description: Seller of a metered deal: redeem the buyer’s latest claim on the ledger (PaymentChannelClaim), pay the fee on the increase from your account (a channel pays only you), and record both. --close also closes the channel, returning the unused rest to the buyer. Moves money: on mainnet pass yes=true only after the person you act for agrees.

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

claim.description: The claim JSON (or a file of it) the buyer printed with cappz-market claim.

close.description: Close the channel in the same transaction.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

name: market_redeem
